## Code Update Description
Brief description of what code needs to be updated and why

## Files/Components Affected
List the specific files, functions, or components that need changes

## Current Behavior
What the code currently does

## Desired Behavior  
What the code should do after the update

## Implementation Notes
- [ ] Any specific approach or considerations
- [ ] Dependencies that might be affected
- [ ] Tests that need to be updated

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles/runs without errors
- [ ] Existing functionality still works
- [ ] New changes work as expected
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed

## Priority
- [ ] Critical (breaks functionality)
- [ ] High (important improvement)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (minor enhancement)

## Additional Context
Links to related issues, documentation, or other relevant information
